raw.details:
What if you could turn your imagination into a game?

Imagine the Impossible is a creative challenge where you take an idea from your imagination and bring it to life as a visual game concept.

From designing your game's universe, characters and missions to creating its poster and pitching your idea, use Google Gemini AI tool to turn your imagination into something people can actually see and experience.

Individual participation only.

Challenge Flow

  • Imagine: Come up with an original game idea with one goal, one enemy and one deadline.
  • Create: Define your game's name, tagline, mission, characters and gameplay mode.
  • Visualise: Use Google Gemini AI to bring your game world and characters to life through visuals.
  • Design: Create an eye-catching game poster showcasing your imagined universe.
  • Present: Pitch your game concept in 60 seconds.
  • Get Voted: Let the audience decide: Would Play or Wouldn't Play?

Submission Requirements

Each participant must submit:

  • Game Name & Tagline
  • Game Mission & Enemy
  • Characters & Game Mode
  • AI-generated Game Poster
  • Google Document containing the complete game concept
  • Shareable Google Gemini chat link used during creation

Google Document sharing must be set to "Anyone with the link can access".

Rules:

  • Individual participation only. No teams allowed.
  • Google Gemini AI must be the only AI tool used throughout the challenge.
  • Use of ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Copilot or any other AI platform is strictly prohibited.
  • All concepts and submissions must be original.
  • Participants must provide their Google Gemini chat link.
  • Only one final submission per participant is allowed.
  • Inappropriate, offensive, plagiarised or misleading content will lead to disqualification.
  • Organisers reserve the right to verify submissions.
  • The decision of the organisers and judges shall be final.

Voting & Evaluation:

  • Participants will present their concepts through a 60-second pitch.
  • Audience voting will follow the Would Play / Wouldn't Play format.
  • Entries will be evaluated on:
  • Originality of the game concept
  • Creativity and storytelling
  • Visual presentation and poster design
  • Overall idea and pitch

Rewards & Recognition:

Winner: A chance to win a smartphone along with a Winner Certificate.

Participation Certificates: Awarded to all eligible participants who submit all required deliverables and complete the submission requirements.

Don't forget to join the WhatsApp Group for more details and further communication.

https://chat.whatsapp.com/LdWsnv6Lg032Ei1HpFlV9G?s=sw&p=i&iam=2

Please Note: Certificates will be issued after successful verification of submissions.
